text_en: To the leader: Do Not Destroy. Of David. A Miktam, when Saul ordered his house to be watched in order to kill him.
text_cn: 达味金诗，交与乐官。调寄"莫要毁坏"。作于撒乌耳为杀害达味，派人窥伺他的寓所时。

text_en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise up against me.
text_cn: 我主，求你由我的仇敌中，救我免难， 求你从攻击我者中，使我脱险；

text_en: Deliver me from those who work evil; from the bloodthirsty save me.
text_cn: 求你救我脱离为非作歹的人， 求你救我远离好流人血的人。

text_en: Even now they lie in wait for my life; the mighty stir up strife against me. For no transgression or sin of mine, O Lord ,
text_cn: 上主，你看，我虽然没有作过恶，没有犯过罪， 但强横人为害我的性命，却群起与我作对。

text_en: for no fault of mine, they run and make ready. Rouse yourself, come to my help and see!
text_cn: 我虽然无辜，他们却跑来挑战， 求你醒来扶助我，且予以察看。

text_en: You, Lord God of hosts, are God of Israel. Awake to punish all the nations; spare none of those who treacherously plot evil. Selah
text_cn: 因为你是上主，万军的天主，以色列的天主， 醒来严罚这些群众，别恩待这些背信恶徒。（休止）

text_en: Each evening they come back, howling like dogs and prowling about the city.
text_cn: 他们晚上归来，狂吠如犬， 他们环绕城池，四周围转。

text_en: There they are, bellowing with their mouths, with sharp words on their lips— for “Who, ” they think, “will hear us? ”
text_cn: 看，他们的唇舌宛如利剑， 且满口傲慢说：“有谁听见？”

text_en: But you laugh at them, O Lord ; you hold all the nations in derision.
text_cn: 但是你，上主，你必嘲笑他们， 你必讥讽这般异民。

text_en: O my strength, I will watch for you; for you, O God, are my fortress.
text_cn: 我的力量，我只有仰望于你， 因为你是天主，是我的堡垒。

text_en: My God in his steadfast love will meet me; my God will let me look in triumph on my enemies.
text_cn: 愿那爱我的天主援助我， 使我因仇敌失败而欢乐！

text_en: Do not kill them, or my people may forget; make them totter by your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
text_cn: 天主，求你击杀他们，免得侵犯我的人民， 上主，我的护盾，你以强力扰乱制服他们。

text_en: For the sin of their mouths, the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride. For the cursing and lies that they utter,
text_cn: 他们口唇所说的话语：就是他们口舌的罪过，愿他们因自己的骄傲咒骂与谎言，自陷网罗！

text_en: consume them in wrath; consume them until they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
text_cn: 求你发怒灭绝他们，灭绝他们无一存立， 使人知道：天主在雅各伯为王，直达地极。 （休止）

text_en: Each evening they come back, howling like dogs and prowling about the city.
text_cn: 他们晚上归来，狂吠如犬， 他们环绕城池，四周围转。

text_en: They roam about for food, and growl if they do not get their fill.
text_cn: 他们到处游荡，觅食糊口。 若不得饱食，便狂吠不休。

text_en: But I will sing of your might; I will sing aloud of your steadfast love in the morning. For you have been a fortress for me and a refuge in the day of my distress.
text_cn: 但是，我要称颂你的威能， 每日清晨欢呼你的宽仁， 因为只有你是我的碉堡， 是我困厄时日的避难所。

text_en: O my strength, I will sing praises to you, for you, O God, are my fortress, the God who shows me steadfast love.
text_cn: 我的力量，我只有向你歌唱， 因为你是天主，是我的保障。 你是我的天主，你对我慈祥。
